text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, cisatracurium besylate is listed by FDA as To Be Discontinued. Corvale East holds 39 vials (2 mg/mL, 10 mL) with 11.2 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 23 vials with 29.6 days on hand. Corvale General holds 126.4 vials with 31.1 days on hand. Atracurium besylate is available at Corvale East (28 vials, 8.3 days) and Corvale General (95.02 vials, 25.5 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA issued a Warning Letter to Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited on 2024-08-15 following prior OAI findings. FDA records show the product status as To Be Discontinued.

Our position: Current inventory supports internal redistribution to cover Corvale East’s near-term need. External purchases are possible from suppliers not on FDA’s shortage list, though their manufacturing sites are not identified on labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 12 vials from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 29 vials from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Evaluate purchase from Armas Pharmaceuticals — approved by buyer.
4. Evaluate purchase from Avenacy, LLC — approved by buyer.
5. Evaluate purchase from Camber Pharmaceuticals Inc. — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical substitution or dosing changes at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
